facts.title: Creamy Thai Carrot Sweet Potato Soup
ingredients: 4 cups low-sodium vegetable broth, plus more if needed
¼ cup raw almond butter or peanut butter
½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt, plus more to taste
Up to ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper
½ cup raw almonds, finely chopped
1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon low-sodium tamari or coconut aminos
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
